name: io.github.ClockNext/mcp
description: Meter usage and manage usage-based billing from AI tools via the ClockNext API.

environmentVariables.name: CLOCKNEXT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your organisation's cnk_… API key (Settings → API Keys).

environmentVariables.name: CLOCKNEXT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API origin (e.g. a staging URL). Defaults to production.

environmentVariables.name: CLOCKNEXT_DOCS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the docs origin for the search_docs/get_doc tools. Defaults to https://help.clocknext.com.
